_provenance.copied_from: abTEM 1.0.10 (PyPI wheel abtem-1.0.10-py3-none-any.whl), files abtem/parametrizations/data/kirkland.json and lobato.json, entry 'Si'
_provenance.evidence: SECTION_READ of the abTEM data files and of abtem/parametrizations/functions/{kirkland,lobato}.py (formula for scattering_factor with raw parameters). The primary sources (Kirkland 2010, Advanced Computing in Electron Microscopy, 2nd ed., Appendix C; Lobato and Van Dyck 2014, Acta Cryst. A 70, 636-649) were NOT read: the transcription of the values into abTEM is UNVERIFIED against them.
_provenance.kirkland_formula: f_e(q) = sum_i a_i/(q^2 + b_i) + sum_i c_i exp(-d_i q^2); rows are [a1,a2,a3],[b1,b2,b3],[c1,c2,c3],[d1,d2,d3]; q in cycles/A (q = 1/d), f_e in A
_provenance.lobato_formula: f_e(q) = sum_i a_i (2 + b_i q^2)/(1 + b_i q^2)^2; rows are [a1..a5],[b1..b5]; q in cycles/A, f_e in A
